description: cross-case memory: a written file of lessons carried from case to case, over the shipped stage of each engine

cases.note: The change from \d+(?:\.\d+)? to \d(?:\.\d+)? is an equivalent refactor. Both patterns match the same set of valid inputs in practice, as the original \d+ already requires at least one digit, and the optional decimal part is handled the same way. The change does not alter observable behavior.

The change incorrectly uses `true` as a condition instead of checking for `options.decimalPlaces !== undefined`, causing `decimalPlaces` to be `undefined` when the option is not provided, which leads to `toFixed(undefined)` defaulting to 0 decimal places.
